hints.title: Bidirectional Cyclic Modular Stepping
hints.text: Traversing an array cyclically allows arbitrary positive or negative index steps, wrapping modulo array length.

hints.title: Two-Way Modular Index Calculation
hints.text: In each cycle, yield the current element. Receive jump distance from next(jump). Advance index using (idx + jump % n + n) % n.

hints.title: Circular Generator Blueprint
hints.text: let idx = startIndex; while (true) { const jump = yield arr[idx]; idx = (idx + (jump ?? 0) % arr.length + arr.length) % arr.length; }

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Computes circular index wrapping in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard modulo % in JavaScript produces negative numbers for negative dividends without ((val % n) + n) % n adjustment.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains single pointer index without array copies.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of negative jump steps and generator two-way communication via yield.
